name: Companion
description: A living companion from companion packs: seal, penguin, robot and more.

setting.packs.desc: Activate companion packs, see errors, open the folder.
setting.recall.desc: Your companion pops up next to you.
setting.companion.desc: Look at it and click to pet. Hold middle mouse to carry it, wheel = size, right click = menu.
setting.name: Name
setting.name.desc: Or right click it with a named name tag.
setting.mode.desc: Stay keeps it at its spot; it wanders around a little.
setting.others.desc: Shows companions of players with Vibey and the same pack.
setting.share.desc: Only pack, position and animation are sent, through the server's Vibey relay.
